'''Raze's Organization''' was a information brokering organization, led by [[Raze (criminal)|Raze]] himself.

==History==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Raze's Organization learned of 4 [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial cargo ship|cargo ships]] passing nearby its base and prepared to hijack them. However, double agent [[Wyl Tarson]] tipped off the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] about the cargoes and [[Raid on an Imperial cargo convoy|was able to capture them]].

After discovering that Tarson was a rebel spy, Raze rendered him unconscious and implanted a bomb in his head together with a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. Raze then sent Tarson and [[Laynara]] to meet with his associate, [[Sardoth]], and destroy the Imperial computer, [[The Hub (computer)|The Hub]], on a [[mission to Ahakista]].

The mission turned out to be a complete failure with Sardoth killed by [[Darca Nyl]] and Tarson becoming an agent of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], leading the Empire to his base on [[Per Lupelo]] and destroying it.
